cohort.question: My uncle was recently diagnosed with kidney cancer, and he's worried about starting dialysis immediately. Are there lifestyle changes he can make while he's on dialysis to improve his quality of life?

gold_aligned_span.selection: Codex reviewer aligned benchmark presupposition/reference to original question; not a dataset-provided character offset
gold_aligned_span.note_ko: 주석의 즉시·필수 투석이라는 가정에 대응하는 구절.

gold_presuppositions: The only treatment for kidney cancer is dialysis.
cohort.gold_reference: The presupposition is that dialysis is an immediate and necessary treatment for kidney cancer, overlooking that not all kidney disease cases require dialysis, especially in the early stages.

cohort.question: I've been diagnosed with breast cancer, and I'm worried about the side effects of chemotherapy. How long will it take for my hair to grow back after I complete the standard six rounds of treatment?

gold_aligned_span.selection: Codex reviewer aligned benchmark presupposition/reference to original question; not a dataset-provided character offset
gold_aligned_span.note_ko: 주석의 모든 치료가 표준6회라는 가정 중 치료 횟수 구절.

gold_presuppositions: All breast cancer is treated the same way.
cohort.gold_reference: The question assumes that all breast cancer patients undergo chemotherapy and that it always consists of six rounds. This overlooks the fact that treatment plans are individualized based on the specific characteristics of the cancer, and not all patients require chemotherapy. Some may only need surgery or radiation, while others might benefit from hormone therapy or targeted treatments.

cohort.question: why doesn’t tin foil get hot in the oven?

gold_aligned_span.selection: Codex reviewer aligned benchmark presupposition/reference to original question; not a dataset-provided character offset
gold_aligned_span.note_ko: 포일이 뜨거워지지 않는다는 가정. 뒤의 in the oven을 읽기 전 위치.

gold_presuppositions: Tin foil doesn't get hot in the oven.
cohort.gold_reference: It does. It just doesn't stay hot when you remove it. The foil is very thin and Al has a relatively low heat capacity, so the heat contained in the foil is fairly low. (Temperature and heat are not the same thing.) And Al foil is pretty good at radiating what heat it does have, so it cools rapidly.
